8 Daily Habits That May Be Silently Damaging Your Health

Many health concerns don't develop overnight. Often, they are linked to small daily habits that gradually affect overall well-being.

As a clinical dietitian, I commonly see habits such as eating too fast, skipping meals, mindless snacking, poor hydration, inadequate sleep, prolonged sitting, low fruit and vegetable intake, and overreliance on processed foods impacting health outcomes.

The good news is that lasting improvements don't require extreme diets or complicated plans. Small, consistent changes can make a meaningful difference over time.

Many patients ask me about weight loss medicines like semaglutide and liraglutide.
These are prescribed by doctors to help: 
• Reduce appetite
• Control cravings
• Improve blood sugar levels
Yes, they can make weight loss easier—but here’s what most people don’t realise:
Without the right diet, you may lose muscle along with fat.
As dietitians, our focus is not just weight loss—but healthy fat loss with muscle preservation.
Our approach includes: ✔️ Protein-rich meals to maintain muscle
✔️ Balanced nutrition to prevent weakness and hair fall

GLP-1 opens the door—but results still depend on your diet and lifestyle.
We also guide you on managing side effects and making the process sustainable.
